info.album: Let Her Cry (Live at the Horseshoe, University of South Carolina, Columbia, SC, 4/19/1996)

podcast.body: This impassioned ballad was issued as the second single from *Cracked Rear View* in March 1995. It quickly climbed the charts, entering the Top 40 by April and the Top 20 by May. "And it was in the top 40 by April, the top 20 by May."

srcs.source: Hit Parade Music History and Music Trivia
